## Purpose

This is a technical software user manual for developers, integrators, testers and
operations/support users who need to obtain, configure, start, stop or diagnose the
software item.

It describes how to use an identified software baseline. It does not define product
requirements, architecture or engineering-process rules.

## Relationship to other documents

This manual is downstream of the released software, configuration/interface baseline
and applicable engineering/runtime documentation.

Specifications and design documents remain the source of product behaviour. SDE
documents remain the source of engineering-environment conventions. This manual tells a
reader which released combination applies and how to run or work with it.
